The '''DuR-4 shield generator''' was a model of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] manufactured by [[Novaplex/Legends|Novaplex]]. [[Salla Zend]]'s ''[[Starlight Intruder]]'' was equipped with four DuR-4 shield generators.<ref name="EGVV" />
